name: Bass Safe
description: Width above 250 Hz only: the low end stays where it was, the top spreads.

name: Ringing Ensemble
description: Three pairs fed back hard through a band in the middle: the voices ring, near a flanger, for leads that sing.

name: Subtle Doubler
description: One pair, a little behind and barely moving: a second take beside the first, for a voice or a guitar.

name: Tempo Swirl
description: Two pairs swept once a bar, deep, so the width breathes with the song.

name: Wide Shimmer
description: Four pairs of voices between 7 and 16 ms, swept slowly and spread wide: a pad or a pluck made broad and alive.
